create_ssd_trainer: create an SSDTrainer instance to fine-tune a language model using embarrassingly simple self-distillation with cross-entropy loss
generate_completion_ids: generate model completions from a list of prompts at a configured training-time temperature using transformers or vLLM
build_buffered_batch: build a buffered training batch by generating completions from prompts and tokenizing them for the forward pass
compute_loss_ssd: compute standard cross-entropy loss on generated completions conditioned on prompts without any reward model or verifier
configure_generation_kwargs: configure generation parameters including temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, and repetition_penalty for self-distillation sampling
